description: Create a release gate pack: a named set of saved tests and schedules, from any project, that a gate runs. It needs at least one test or schedule. Then create a gate for it with create_release_gate.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

schedule.description: The schedule's id, as list_schedules shows it.
schedule.title: Schedule

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

test.description: The saved test's id, as list_tests shows it.
test.title: Test

schedules.description: Scheduled tests, each {"project": number or name, "schedule": id}, as list_schedules shows them.
schedules.title: Schedules

tests.description: Saved tests, each {"project": number or name, "test": id}. A pack may hold tests of several projects.
tests.title: Tests

name: create_gate_pack
